candidateAudit.text: 💘 Friends? Dates? Flirting? Something in between? Meet queer people in Vienna without swiping. 📅 Sat, 26 September 2026 ⏰ 19:00–21:00 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna 🎟️ €20 per person · cash at the door 💛 Soli tickets available 📝 Registration required 🌈 Who is it for? Queer people who want to meet other queer people — whether you’re looking for dating, friendship, flirting, new connections, or simply meeting more of the community. You’ll meet multiple people through a series of short mini-dates. Privately note who you’d like to connect with again — romantically, platonically, or otherwise. If you both choose each other, it’s a match. 💌 Contact information is only shared with mutual matches. 🧍 Coming alone? Absolutely. You don’t need to know anyone beforehand. The structured format is there to make meeting people easier, including if you’re shy, introverted, or not into approaching strangers at a bar. 💛 Can’t comfortably afford €20? Soli tickets are available. Request one in the comments when registering — no explanation or justification needed. 🤝 Consent, boundaries and mutual respect are essential. A conversation or flirtation never creates an obligation to share contact details or meet again. Discriminatory or harassing behaviour is not welcome. ♿ Step-free access · accessible seating & toilet · service animals welcome. Please note that simultaneous conversations can mean significant background noise. 📝 Register via the link in bio/event page. Come as you are and see who you click with. 💘

candidateAudit.text: What might consciousness smell like? Is it possible to sense interdependencies? Would you like to experience your embeddedness in the world? The SΫS SPACE prototype by artists duo MUELLER-DIVJAK opens its doors for two afternoons in September, inviting you for a one-of-a-kind experience, an exclusive multisensory trail of resonating with and better understanding of living systems. ⚡⚡⚡Currently all individual time slots are taken, but you can sign up for the waiting list! Find the link in our bio! Exclusive one-hour slot for a fascinating journey into your senses and search for a being that knows and feels everything about connectedness and interdependence. The artist and researcher duo MUELLER-DIVJAK (Dr. Jeanette Müller and Dr. Paul Divjak), who is working at the AIL with international artists and systems scientists on the FWF/PEEK project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenographies for Systems Awareness (Project lead: Mag. Alexandra Graupner; University of Applied Arts), is devoted to creating experiential multisensory spaces – the so called SΫS SPACEs – that help enhancing systems awareness through special sensory cues. Such allowing for coping resiliently with the complex interrelations and interactions that shape our world and all our lives. mueller_divjak dieangewandte

candidateAudit.text: Every great journey tells a story. This one begins aboard a moving piece of Vienna's history. Step onto a beautifully restored historic tram and watch the city unfold as a Sicilian aperitivo sets the tone for an unforgettable evening. As imperial Vienna glides by, the journey slowly carries you south - to the vibrant flavors, traditions, and spirit of Sicily. Awaiting at the final stop is Pastamara - Bar con Cucina, where the legacy of Ragusa comes to life through an extraordinary dining experience. Every course is a celebration of heritage, craftsmanship, and the unmistakable warmth of Italian hospitality. The Pastamara Express is more than a tram ride. More than an exceptional dinner. It is a journey between two cultures, where the elegance of Vienna meets the soul of Sicily—one unforgettable evening, one remarkable table, one extraordinary experience. #rcmemories #TheRitzCarltonVienna #vienna

candidateAudit.title: The Unsafe+Sounds festival, held annually in Vienna, returns in September with a kaleidoscopic program, offering a multifaceted glimpse into the contemporary music scene and AIL is
candidateAudit.text: The Unsafe+Sounds festival, held annually in Vienna, returns in September with a kaleidoscopic program, offering a multifaceted glimpse into the contemporary music scene and AIL is delighted to once again host one event in the program. unsafeandsounds AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna (Free entry) Overview: 18:30 Panel Discussion, unsafe+sounds in cooperation with the Weibel Institute for Digital Cultures (University of Applied Arts Vienna) weibel.institute Affective Histories Timotheus Vermeulen and Christian Höller in conversation with Sophie Publig History is never simply given. It is made through the scales and materials by which the past becomes legible: from sweeping narratives and historical events to gestures, sounds, images, technical infrastructures, and seemingly minor traces SOPHIE PUBLIG is a Senior Scientist researching digital ecosystems. Based at the Weibel Institute for Digital Cultures at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, she navigates the intricate networks of online territories. TIMOTHEUS VERMEULEN is Professor of Media, Culture and Society at the University of Oslo and joint director of the Media Aesthetics Research Group. He was a visiting scholar in Art History at Harvard in 2023–24 and will serve as joint Principal Investigator on a project on the politics of tone at the Centre for Advanced Study in Oslo in 2027–28. CHRISTIAN HÖLLER is editor and co-publisher of springerin – Hefte für Gegenwartskunst. Since 2024 he is head of the department Cross Disciplinary Strategies at the University of Applied Arts Vienna. cro

candidateAudit.title: Thirsty Thursdays BACK ON! Vol. 7: Am 15. Oktober kosten wir uns quer durch die Weine von Yann Durieux mit seiner Burgunder Domäne „Recrue des Sens“. Schauplatz Hautes-Côtes de Nui
candidateAudit.text: Thirsty Thursdays BACK ON! Vol. 7: Am 15. Oktober kosten wir uns quer durch die Weine von Yann Durieux mit seiner Burgunder Domäne „Recrue des Sens“. Schauplatz Hautes-Côtes de Nuits, wo Yann nach seiner Lehrzeit bei Prieuré-Roch kleine Flächen alter Reben in Toplagen übernehmen konnte - ausgepflanzt und pioniert vom Großvater. Heute keltert Yann hier mit die besten Weine dieser jungen, hochspannenden Appellation. Nebenbei konnte er über die Jahre winzige Parzellen entlang der Côte d’Or übernehmen. Yanns Zugang ist radikal naturnah, terroirverliebt, perfektionistisch. Wir gehen dem „Phantom der Côte“ auf den Grund. This is more than a wine tasting. More than a day in the vineyards. It is a journey into the heritage, craftsmanship, and passion behind every bottle. candidateAudit.title: Throughout August and September, the artist duo MUELLER-DIVJAK is residing at AIL for Summer Studio – using the space for artistic research, experimentation, and learning, developi
candidateAudit.text: Throughout August and September, the artist duo MUELLER-DIVJAK is residing at AIL for Summer Studio – using the space for artistic research, experimentation, and learning, developing the project's multisensory scenography – the so-called SΫS SPACE. Aim of the Summer Studio is to prepare the prototype of the scenography, which will be established at the AIL in June 2027 as the centerpiece of the final exhibition of the PEEK project ’SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS — Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness.’ The SΫS SPACE facilitates a physical experience of one's own embededdness within living systems, within complex interrelationships – within a greater whole. It paves the way for relational sensing and thinking – an embodied systems awareness, that can help in coping with complexity, challenges, and uncertainties, and in making good decisions towards sustainable futures. It deliberately reduces the dominance of the sense of sight, placing the emphasis instead on smell, touch, and hearing. Numerous scientists, as well as invited artists, politicians, journalists, children, senior citizens, curators, cultural workers, educators, and teenagers are individually guided through the immersive environment by Jeanette Müller and Paul Divjak and share their responses in photo-based reflections and semi-structured interviews. Their feedback directly informs the prototype. Save the date! 14 and 15 Sep 2026 The SΫS SPACE will open to the public in individual time slots for an exclusive multisensory experience. candidateAudit.title: NEW BLOG: Wir stellen vor: Weingut Sommer aus Donnerskirchen. Mit unserem jüngsten Neuzugang zieht es uns wieder einmal ans Leithagebirge. Hier spielt allerdings neben dem Leithaka
candidateAudit.text: NEW BLOG: Wir stellen vor: Weingut Sommer aus Donnerskirchen. Mit unserem jüngsten Neuzugang zieht es uns wieder einmal ans Leithagebirge. Hier spielt allerdings neben dem Leithakalk vor allem der Schieferboden die Hauptrolle. In steilen Höhenlagen wie dem Donnerskirchner Bergweingarten und der Ried Himmelreich stoßen wir auf einen unerwarteten Bekannten: Grünen Veltliner! Leo und Kathrin, die das Familienweingut über die letzten Jahre übernommen haben (und damit uralte Veltliner Bestände in eben genannten Toplagen), beweisen uns Jahr für Jahr das immense Potenzial unserer Nationalrebe im Leithagebirge. Wer „little sister“ und „Salz und Rauch“ noch nicht probiert hat, hat noch nicht gelebt. Mit Neugier und Tatendrang widmen sich die beiden außerdem in ihrer „Handwerk“ Linie der Artenvielfalt des pannonischen Raums, von alten Welsch Parzellen bis zu neuen Experimenten mit Furmint, dem urspätreifenden Somm-Favorit, oder „Chenin des Ostens“, Zitat Autor. ;) Mit ihrem handwerklichen, naturnahen und bedachten Zugang haben sich Leo und Kathrin über wenige Jahre klar an der Spitze der österreichischen Weinwelt gefunden. Und ihr Wein wird jedes Jahr besser. *** BLOG ONLINE *** #pubklemo #winebar #wineshop #austria #leithaberg

candidateAudit.text: 🎬 Sapphic Film Series: Rebel Dykes Punk meets feminism at the next edition of our Sapphic Film Series at Villa Vida Café. 🖤 Join us for a free screening of Rebel Dykes, a documentary exploring the lives of a group of lesbians who helped shape a radical queer subculture in 1980s London. Through stories of friendship, sex, activism, nightlife, art and resistance, Rebel Dykes takes us into a world where punk collided with feminism and queer people created their own spaces, communities and ways of living. Rather than presenting queer history as something distant or polished, the documentary is told through the people who were there — the rebels who lived, loved, organised, partied and challenged expectations both inside and outside feminist movements. This edition of the Sapphic Film Series is hosted and curated by ni.pi_art 📅 Thursday, 20 August 2026 🕖 19:00 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna 🎟️ Free entry – no registration necessary 🌈 Who’s welcome? Everyone who wants to engage respectfully with sapphic and queer cinema. The series centres sapphic stories and experiences, but you do not need to identify as sapphic or queer to attend. candidateAudit.title: Every drag performance tells a story. Whether it’s joyful, political, deeply personal, or completely absurd, the most memorable performances come from artists who know how to conne
candidateAudit.text: Every drag performance tells a story. Whether it’s joyful, political, deeply personal, or completely absurd, the most memorable performances come from artists who know how to connect with an audience. Join drag artist DaDa JV for an interactive workshop exploring the art of storytelling through drag and performance. Together, you’ll look at how movement, music, character, costume, emotion, and stage presence work together to create performances that leave a lasting impact. This workshop is open to performers of all experience levels, from those taking their first steps into drag to seasoned artists looking to deepen their creative practice. Participants are encouraged to bring ideas, works in progress, or simply their curiosity. Together we’ll explore: • Finding your unique performance voice • Building a story through movement and music • Connecting authentically with an audience • Using drag as a tool for self expression and community • Developing confidence on stage Expect a welcoming, collaborative environment where experimentation is encouraged and every participant’s perspective is valued. Event Details Saturday, August 29 4:00 PM Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna This workshop is donation based. Give what you can. No one will be turned away for lack of funds. Come ready to learn, share, and discover new ways to bring your story to life on stage.

candidateAudit.text: Looking for a relaxed evening of games and great company? Join Gayme Night Vienna at Villa Vida Café for a free community board game night where everyone is welcome. Whether you’re an experienced strategist, a casual player, or completely new to board games, Gayme Night is all about meeting people, sharing laughs, and enjoying a welcoming queer space. Bring your favourite game or choose from our growing collection of board and card games. Come with friends or come on your own—there’s always a table to join. Event Details 📅 Date: Friday, 29 August 🕕 Time: 18:00–21:00 📍 Location: Villa Vida Café, Vienna 💸 Entry: Free No registration is required. Simply drop by whenever you’d like during the evening. What to Expect at Gayme Night At Gayme Night Vienna, you’ll find: * A relaxed and welcoming atmosphere * Classic and modern board games * Card games and party games * Opportunities to meet new people * Delicious drinks and food available throughout the evening * A community space where everyone is welcome Whether you enjoy cooperative adventures, competitive strategy games, quick party games, or social deduction, there’s something for every play style. Who Can Join? Gayme Night Vienna is open to everyone. Villa Vida Café is a queer community café that welcomes people of all genders, sexual orientations, identities, backgrounds, and experience levels. Whether it’s your first visit or you’re already part of the community, you’ll find a friendly and inclusive space. Come solo, bring a partner, invite friends, or meet new people during the evening. Accessibility Information Villa

candidateAudit.title: Over the past season, every spin, every step, and every dance has made a real difference. 💜 Thanks to your generosity, Queer Salsa Wien has raised over €850 for the Queer Vienna M
candidateAudit.text: Over the past season, every spin, every step, and every dance has made a real difference. 💜 Thanks to your generosity, Queer Salsa Wien has raised over €850 for the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund (QVMAF) this year already. The Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund provides one-off emergency microgrants to queer people in Vienna experiencing unexpected financial hardship. Whether someone is struggling to pay rent, buy groceries, cover medical costs, or get through another crisis, these grants help community members when they need it most. A huge thank you to the incredible Queer Salsa Wien team for organising these classes, and to everyone who has danced, donated, volunteered, and supported this initiative. Every donation, no matter the size, helps build a stronger community based on solidarity and mutual care. Queer Salsa classes will be back at Villa Vida in October but in the meantime you can join their outdoor classes and parties. Follow queersalsawien for information. The Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund is an initiative started by hint.wien and villavidacafe. If you’d like to learn more about the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund or make a donation, visit queervienna.at. See you on the dance floor soon. 💃🏽🕺🏿❤️ 💜 Thank you, queersalsawien ! Over €850 raised for the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund in 2026—thank you to everyone who danced and donated. QVMAF provides emergency microgrants to queer people in Vienna facing unexpected financial hardship. Learn more or support the fund at queervienna.at

candidateAudit.text: 2.185 € für Venezuela. ❤️🇻🇪 Dank eurer unglaublichen Unterstützung konnten wir in den letzten Tagen 2.185 € sammeln. Mit diesem Geld kaufen wir weitere dringend benötigte Sachspenden, die gemeinsam mit unserem Container nach Venezuela geschickt werden. Ein riesiges Dankeschön an den javaneh.verein Verein, josephavilag sowie alle Künstlerinnen und Künstler, die ihre Werke für das Benefizevent #WienHilftVenezuela gespendet haben. ❤️ Ebenso bedanken wir uns bei den viennavikings , dem hrcvienna , fiestaviena und cellavie_aviation_club für ihre wertvolle Unterstützung. Unser Container füllt sich jeden Tag ein Stück mehr und das ist nur dank euch möglich. 📦 Kennt ihr Unternehmen, Vereine oder Organisationen, die unsere Hilfsaktion unterstützen möchten? Dann teilt diesen Beitrag und helft uns, noch mehr Menschen zu erreichen. Jede Unterstützung zählt. Danke von Herzen. 🇦🇹🤝🇻🇪 #ErdbebenHilfe #Wien #Spenden #Venezuela

candidateAudit.title: The exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory is still running till this Friday, July 10! Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 Last guided tour: Thur, July 9, 17:00 Memory is not
candidateAudit.text: The exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory is still running till this Friday, July 10! Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 Last guided tour: Thur, July 9, 17:00 Memory is not a stable record of the past. Rather than functioning as a static archive, it unfolds as a dynamic process in which traces are continuously reshaped by perception, narration, and material conditions. Across these artistic approaches, [REVERBERATED] invites visitors to consider memory not as something simply preserved, but as something continuously produced through interactions between bodies, technologies, and environments. The exhibition thus explores how the past continues to reverberate within the systems of the present. With contributions by: Agustina Belén Agüero, Lobna Awidat, Phin Anibal, Rimon Alyagon Darr, Ronnie Danaher, Tatiana Del Valle, Hasti Ghasedi, Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz, Hanna Hofmann, Tal Horesh, Mauritius Itzinger, Laura Isselhorst, Dina Karaman, Moritz Klarer, Anna Buchner, Leonard Otterbein, David Ristić, Rajarshi Sarkar, Agnes Schyberg, Aryan Shahabian, Majedeh Shahvelayati, Mehrta Shirzadian, Pauline Simon, Laura Chalabi, People of Soil Photos: Lea Dörl

candidateAudit.text: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafik In collaborative drawing, two people share a single pen – the line becomes a space of negotiation. A play between control and letting go. Who leads – and when? Impulse meets resistance, conviction meets empathy. Not always a conversation, but always an understanding – a dance on paper. These and other experiments are part of the course “Drawing: Here & Now” by Simon Goritschnig, in which students of the department Drawing and Printmaking explore various qualities of drawing beyond observational study. In the project “Reflex,” these experimental setups are set against observational drawing. Students draw in the cashier hall of the former Postsparkasse, intuitively picking up details from architecture and space, as well as situations of coming together: conversations, movements, gazes. In this process, it becomes visible how public and social space is visually probed and explored. The focus lies on reflection — with, through, and within drawing. With contributions by: Andrea Vairelles, Anna Marino, Beth Sorby, Emilia Schönwiese, Flora Schmid, Hannah Horn, Henriette Sonntag, Leo Hasslinger, Maria Lutkova, Max Offergeld, Nikolaus Kohout, Sophie Schweizer, Anija S Dartizio, Timo Pfeifer, Vera Kügel AIL in cooperation with the department Drawing and Printmaking and Simon Goritschnig Image: Henriette Sonntag Design: Atelier Dreibholz Concept Postcard Editions and Production: Eva Weber

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 4 Jul 2026, 15:00 The Geography of Yellow Walls Performance by Mehrta Shirzadian mehrrta Bright yellow becomes a quiet declaration of care, resistance, and return. Here, the body is reclaimed as homeland, shaped by experience rather than imposed borders. A performance unfolding through turmeric as healing material and the body as living territory. The work is rooted in a deep commitment to women’s health and critical scientific perspectives, engaging forms of embodied knowledge that have long been ignored or erased. The body becomes both evidence and memory, offering its own geography as a space of protection, defiance, and belonging. The performance is adapted to each site, responding to the spatial and contextual conditions of different venues. Mehrta Shirzadian is a performance and multimedia artist and artistic ­researcher working at the intersection of art and science. With a background in molecular biology, mathematics, and computer science, she creates participatory works exploring microbial life, sound, and bodily ecologies, addressing embodiment, agency, and the politics of representation. candidateAudit.text: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alternative investment platform that explores the cultural, economic, and emotional afterlife of the collapse of René Benko’s SIGNA empire. Through NFTs, merchandise, video works, and performative sales strategies, the project examines how value is produced through speculation, narrative, and collective belief. Originally developed through public interventions, the project was expanded through a student take over by Digitale Kunst. This exhibition presents new project strands developed by the students: an NFT series reflecting on financial dependency, a merchandise collection appropriating the aesthetics of startup culture and luxury branding, and a series of short-form videos combining influencer culture, promotional performance, and social commentary. Operating at the intersection of installation, performance, and participatory fiction, Renés Collapse Collection invites visitors to engage directly with the mechanisms of speculation, value production, and collapse. A project by by Zora Hünermann and Jakob Margit With contributions by: Ulrike Fritzsche, Koschka Cosmo Keye, Juarez Suarez, Ghanishka Kedar, Sei Jeung, Ghazal Naeimi, Dongjoo Kim, Jazzmin, Margherita Pruneti, Nicolás Henao Bonnet, Roma Bogdanov, and Grisha Terno.

candidateAudit.title: In a world that is seemingly always connected, we lose ourselves in constant contact. As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Sich zusammen schreiben [to get in touch], A per
candidateAudit.text: In a world that is seemingly always connected, we lose ourselves in constant contact. As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Sich zusammen schreiben [to get in touch], A performance and poem by Carla Schwering and Timna Lugstein from by the department of Institute of Fine Arts & Media Art – Photography (Sophie Thun) The phrase "Schreiben wir uns zusammen" that on the surface means something like “let’s write to each other again in more detail” actually implies a postponement. In the performance, the artists type excerpts from their shared chat history in a poetic arrangement on two typewriters facing each other – messages in which they attempt to get closer to one another. The time and effort spent cancelling meet ups, for which there is supposedly no capacity is made visible. With the postcards created for the performance, visitors can reconnect with a long-lost friend. On the occasion of Angewandte Festival AIL hosts a selection of performances and installations in the cashier hall and the current exhibition will have more activations. We will give you an overview, step by step AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 Jul 2026, 15:30 Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) Performance by Leonard Otterbein leonard.ottb The audio performance Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) explores how sound can model processes of memory formation and transformation. Layered oscillations and brief sound textures repeat with phase shifts, gradually overlapping and partially canceling each other out, much like the traces in an overwritten manuscript. The work is inspired by memory research on reconsolidation – in which recalling an event alters its stored form – and its cultural studies counterpart, reconstructivity. The piece is composed of multiple layers of sound that continuously overlap anew, attempting to cancel each other out in the process. In this process, however, the layers are never completely erased, so that fragments of the preceding states always remain Leonard Otterbein is a sound artist and composer with a background in ecology and ecotoxicology, where he studied mixture effects of agricultural pesticides and nanoparticles. His work spans instrumental and electroacoustic composition, examining perceptual thresholds. He works with psychoacoustic effects and approaches sound as spatial and sculptural material shaped by its relation to space. Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. candidateAudit.title: From the project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness – a performance by mueller_divjak in front of Otto Wagner Postsp
candidateAudit.text: From the project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness – a performance by mueller_divjak in front of Otto Wagner Postsparkasse as part of Angewandte Festival! 'LIMINAL TRACES. Celebrating Acoustic Ecologies' is a dynamic sound lecture that understands the acoustic world as a phenomenon of resonance, shaped by connectedness and interaction. Through the live-curated interplay of field recordings, physical and digital artefacts, the performance traces sonic imprints deeply embedded in our collective memory, presenting them as a new listening experience. Developed within SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS at the AIL, this solar performance explores the intersections of sound, pop history and solar energy, celebrating concept, improvisation and the (unexpected) emergent. The performance ends when the energy collected by the mobile solar unit runs out. — The artist and researcher duo MUELLER-DIVJAK (Dr. Jeanette Müller and Dr. Paul Divjak), who conceived and initiated SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS, is working since 2023 at AIL with international artists and systems scientists to form experiential spaces by artistic means (scenographies) and to create sensory impressions that help us to better understand and resonate with living systems. During the project essential principles of living systems are transformed into olfactory, auditory and tactile artworks / artefacts and used experimentally. Team: Jeanette Müller, Paul Divjak, Alexandra Graupner, Anna-Maria Irgang

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 July 2026, 15:00 Hypervigilant Performance by Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz iukumukui Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory artscience.ak Constant vigilance can develop as a response to racial discrimination and transgenerational trauma, allowing potential threats to be recognized in advance. This fight-or-flight state activates the nervous system and can lead to chronic muscle tension and bruxism. Teeth grinding occurs as a way of coping with stress during sleep, often driven by societal expectations to suppress fear or anger. Hypervigilant addresses this suppressed anger. Aluminum teeth suspended from the ceiling form a space similar to a cage that oscillates between protection and exposure. Shaped as gong-like instruments, the oversized representation of the artist’s bite is set into vibration during a sound performance to release embodied pressure and reduce tension in the nervous system. Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz’s practice centers on suppressed experiences expressed in imagined worlds. Through performative sculptures and installations, she examines spatial dynamics and power structures. Addressing socio-political themes such as racism, sexism, gender, and sexuality, she builds subconscious environments using reference-based objects and constructions in combination with text and sound. candidateAudit.text: 🇦🇹🇻🇪 #ViennaHelpingVenezuela Tausende Familien haben durch das Erdbeben ihr Zuhause verloren und stehen vor einer ungewissen Zukunft. Deshalb möchten wir als Aguacate Latin Food nicht einfach zusehen. Ab heute sammeln wir in Wien Spenden und Hilfsgüter, um betroffene Familien in Venezuela zu unterstützen. Sobald genügend Hilfsgüter zusammenkommen, organisieren wir einen Transport nach Venezuela. WICHTIG: Es handelt sich nicht um eine SOFORT-Hilfe, sondern um Hilfe für die Wochen und Monate nach dieser Katastrophe in der sich Familien ihre Existenzen erneut aufbauen müssen. 📍 Sachspenden können ab sofort hier abgegeben werden: Aguacate Latin Food Mohsgasse 28 1030 Wien Auf unserer Website findet ihr eine vollständige Liste aller aktuell benötigten Hilfsgüter. Auch Unternehmen, Vereine und Organisationen sind herzlich eingeladen, diese Initiative zu unterstützen. Sei es durch Spenden oder als weitere Sammelstelle. Jeder Beitrag zählt. Jede geteilte Story erreicht neue Menschen. Gemeinsam können wir von Wien aus etwas Großes bewirken. De todo corazón, esperamos que sus familiares y seres queridos se encuentren bien. Danke, dass ihr gemeinsam mit uns Venezuela unterstützt. 🇻🇪❤️ #Venezuela #Erdbeben #Wien #GemeinsamHelfen

candidateAudit.title: As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Performance by Laura Oyuela and Ádám Salomvári (students of the department Cross-Disciplinary Strategies) Rocks, I mean; - Stars is a
candidateAudit.text: As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Performance by Laura Oyuela and Ádám Salomvári (students of the department Cross-Disciplinary Strategies) Rocks, I mean; - Stars is a sonic and spatial performance departing from text, soundscapes, spoken words and its physical surrounding. The piece works with analogies between black holes and human beings through low frequencies, orbital motion, and stretched time, shaping a field that gathers bodies into one another. The project investigates how perceptual, cognitive, and affective dynamics shape the experience of artistic performance in relation to contemporary conditions of subjectivity, particularly isolation and hyperproductivity. The performance is part of the Cross-Disciplinary Strategies Master’s program exhibition 2026. The work is realised with the technical support of ÆSR Lab, which has contributed to its sonic and spatial development. Photo: earthboundeva

candidateAudit.text: This is Bome. A collective hub. Not just a coffee shop. Not just a toast atelier. The name comes from our mother tongue, Kurdish. Bome means crazy like us, like our whole team. Crazy enough to be ambitious. Crazy enough to build everything with our own hands. Crazy enough to turn creativity into a place. This is where people meet. Ideas collide. Creative minds feel at home. So be a Bome. Because life is too short to be regular and crazy people have way more fun anyway. It’s not just coffee. It’s a vibe. It’s a hub. It’s Bome #viennacoffee #kurdish #viennalife #coffeeshopvibes

candidateAudit.text: 🍽️ We found a new date spot in Vienna! 🥂 mariaundjosefofficial serves Mediterranean cuisine and is centrally located in the 6th district. 🤩 The interior design is modern and elegant definitely a great spot for a date or a relaxed dinner with friends. 😮‍💨 We especially enjoyed the “Muuuh” with burrata, beets and sweet potato. Another highlight was “Sweet Korl“ and “Spicy Octopus“, served with grilled vegetables and lemon aioli, highly recommended! We tried almost the entire menu and still felt „light“ afterwards, which honestly feels like a small miracle. 🤪 Mediterranean cuisine just hits different and is always a must-try. 🍋 Oliventapenade 7,50€ Muuuh 19,50€ Was-hab-i 16,50€ Bittersweet Symphony 16,50€ Sweet Korl 18,90€ Spicy Octopus 25,90€ Berberitzenbasmati 5,80€ 📍Rahlgasse 1, 1060 Vienna #dinnerdate #viennarestaurant #viennafoodie #viennafood (invitation)

candidateAudit.title: Learning when and how to open is also part of the journey. There’s no point in pushing ourselves to open every weekend just because “something” might happen. In the restaurant worl
candidateAudit.text: Learning when and how to open is also part of the journey. There’s no point in pushing ourselves to open every weekend just because “something” might happen. In the restaurant world, there’s always that bittersweet feeling, being open while everyone else is resting or celebrating with their loved ones. Here in Vienna, following the rhythm and culture of life around us, we’ve decided to close this Saturday (01-11-2025) — to honor our departed, recharge, and gather energy to welcome you on Sunday (02-11-2025) full of warmth and vitality. Light a candle, celebrate those who are here and those who are gone, and we’ll see you on Sunday! ❤️‍🔥✨🕯️ #wienevents #viennafoodies #wienfood #viennaeats #küchefüralle #seasonaleatsvienna #viennaeats #diversecuisine #communitykitchen

candidateAudit.title: To “dialogue between communities” is not just about creating spaces centered around money or spending time among different people. It’s more than that. It’s about building safe spa
candidateAudit.text: To “dialogue between communities” is not just about creating spaces centered around money or spending time among different people. It’s more than that. It’s about building safe spaces where these interactions can happen in ways that reduce harm and allow something new and nourishing to grow. In our case, we began by gently raising awareness around topics like race, gender, and origin, in a tender, first-person way. These moments act as soft entry points, or teasers, for deeper conversations that move beyond surface-level differences. The goal is to create safe, meaningful experiences around food, not harm with rouge interactions. Deep thanks to felipesomething for co-creating this space with us, and to everyone who helped from proofreading to printing. 💞✨

candidateAudit.title: Cappuccino dopo le 12? Cappuccino nach 12 Uhr? 🇦🇹 Warum trinkt man in Italien nachmittags keinen Cappuccino? ☕ Cappuccino wurde als Frühstücksgetränk erfunden, oft mit Croissant,
candidateAudit.text: Cappuccino dopo le 12? Cappuccino nach 12 Uhr? 🇦🇹 Warum trinkt man in Italien nachmittags keinen Cappuccino? ☕ Cappuccino wurde als Frühstücksgetränk erfunden, oft mit Croissant, um morgens Energie zu geben. 🥛 Milch gilt als „schweres“ Lebensmittel: Nach dem Mittagessen ist Espresso leichter und fördert die Verdauung. 🍴 Cappuccino morgens, Espresso nach den Mahlzeiten: eine ungeschriebene Regel der italienischen Kultur. 🌍 Im Ausland trinkt man Cappuccino zu jeder Tageszeit, in Italien hingegen ist er ein Symbol für Frühstück und Alltagskultur. ⸻ 🇮🇹 Perché in Italia non si beve cappuccino dopo mezzogiorno? ☕ Il cappuccino nasce come bevanda da colazione, spesso con brioche, per dare energia al mattino. 🥛 Il latte è considerato “pesante”: dopo pranzo meglio un espresso, più leggero e digestivo. 🍴 Cappuccino al mattino, espresso dopo i pasti: è una regola non scritta della cultura italiana. 🌍 All’estero si beve cappuccino a ogni ora, ma in Italia è simbolo di colazione e tradizione quotidiana. #wien #15district #italienischespezialität #capuccino #coffeebreak #dalpirata #italianfoodlover #italy #dolcevita

candidateAudit.text: THANK YOU ALL! We are still processing everything that happened last Saturday at the opening. candidateAudit.text: As we create this gathering space around food, we are also weaving a net in which every single part of the chain is deeply important. The farmers are the true magicians of life, of nourishment. Thanks to their hands and wisdom, we can enjoy beautiful and healthy dishes that nurture every single cell of our being. Yesterday we visited Tristan and his team. We picked what we fell in love with and also transformed the food right there, sharing OneTable in the middle of paradise with our crew and theirs. You can find Tristan just outside Waldviertel, at his amazing organic farm—growing food with his team, offering workshops, conducting university research, making music, and creating other inspiring projects. You can discover more about his work here: https://biosain.at/ This is growing really pretty. Already grateful for each step of this project. 💚🌱✨ Während wir diesen Treffpunkt rund um das Thema Essen schaffen, knüpfen wir gleichzeitig ein Netz, in dem jeder einzelne Teil der Kette von großer Bedeutung ist. Die Bauern sind die wahren Zauberer des Lebens, der Ernährung. Dank ihrer Hände und ihrer Weisheit können wir wunderschöne und gesunde Gerichte genießen, die jede einzelne Zelle unseres Körpers nähren. Gestern haben wir Tristan und sein Team besucht. Wir haben ausgewählt, was uns gefallen hat, und die Lebensmittel direkt vor Ort verarbeitet, um OneTable mitten im Paradies mit unserem und ihrem Team zu teilen. candidateAudit.text: 🚤 Adjaruli Khachapuri – das „Brotboot“ aus Georgien 🇬🇪🧀🍳 Unser hausgemachtes Adjaruli Khachapuri ist ein echtes Highlight der georgischen Küche 🇬🇪 – direkt aus der Region Adscharien am Schwarzen Meer. Die einzigartige Bootsform steht sinnbildlich für die adjarische Tradition als Bootsbauer – mit geschmolzenem Käse als „Meer“ und einem flüssigen Eigelb als „Sonne“. Heiß serviert, herzhaft, käsig und einfach zum Eintauchen: Sobald das Ei verquirlt ist, tunkt man am besten die Brotränder direkt in die cremige Käse-Ei-Mischung. candidateAudit.text: Die georgische Schrift ist so einzigartig wie die Kultur, die sie repräsentiert. Mit ihren eleganten, runden Formen und einer Geschichte, die über 1.600 Jahre zurückreicht, ist sie ein Symbol für die Tiefe und Schönheit Georgiens. 🇬🇪✨ Genau diese Tradition bringen wir nach Wien – mit authentischen georgischen Spezialitäten und einer der ältesten Weintraditionen der Welt. Ob ein Glas aromatischer Tsinandali, ein eleganter Weißwein mit floralen Noten, oder ein kräftiger Saperavi mit tiefroter Farbe und intensiven Beerenaromen – bei MODI 1080 erlebt ihr echte georgische Genusskultur. Unser Gastwirt Gio wählt die Weine persönlich von georgischen Weinbauern aus, um euch den besten und authentischsten Geschmack zu garantieren. 🍷 #Modi1080 #GeorgischeKultur #GeorgischerWein #Saperavi #Tsinandali

candidateAudit.text: Liebe Naschkatzen, werte Schleckermäuler, Schokoholics und Lakritzfreunde! Wir haben einen betriebsamen Adventauftakt hinter uns - vielen Dank, dass ihr uns so zahlreich besucht und wir euch die Weihnachtszeit versüßen dürfen! Wir erlauben uns einen kleinen Service-Post in eigener Sache: falls ihr eure in unserem Onlineshop bestellten Glückshormone pünktlich zu Weihnachten unter dem Christbaum haben wollt, tätigt eure Bestellungen bitte bis spätestens Dienstag, den 17.12.2024. Danach stehen wir euch noch für kurzfristige Geschenkesuche und Eigenbedarfsdeckung bis zum 24.12., 14 Uhr im Geschäft zur Verfügung. Ausserdem haben wir auch kommende Woche noch zusätzlich samstags von 11-16h geöffnet. Wir wünschen euch weiterhin einen schönen Advent und freuen uns über eure Besuche und Bestellungen! Mit Eck-stra süßen Grüßen, Raphaela & Nicole

candidateAudit.title: Liebe Naschkatzen, werte Schleckermäuler, Schokoholics und Lakritzfreunde! Wie viele wahrscheinlich bereits mitbekommen haben, hat sich das liebe Ehepaar Kornherr in den wohlverdie
candidateAudit.text: Liebe Naschkatzen, werte Schleckermäuler, Schokoholics und Lakritzfreunde! Wie viele wahrscheinlich bereits mitbekommen haben, hat sich das liebe Ehepaar Kornherr in den wohlverdienten Ruhestand verabschiedet und das süße Eck vertrauensvoll in unsere Hände gelegt. Wir sind Nicole Heinrich und Raphaela Mastella und vielleicht kennen uns manche von euch als Backterium, das ist unsere 10 Jahre alte Auftragskonditorei. Einige Kunden durften wir in den letzten Wochen bereits persönlich kennenlernen und dabei schon einiges über eure Lieblingsprodukte lernen, die wir natürlich weiterhin im Sortiment haben werden. Schließlich soll niemand auf seine Trüffelkugeln, Lieblingslakritze, Schichtnougat oder lieb gewonnenes Blockmalz verzichten müssen. Trotzdem dürft ihr gespannt auf ein paar süsse Sortimentserweiterungen sein. Den Juli und Anfang August werden wir gut nutzen um uns in unserem neuen Zuhause einzurichten und für euch vorzukosten damit wir mit 26. August persönlich für euch da sein können. Wer sich, verständlicherweise, die Wartezeit versüßen möchte, kann sich gerne in unserem Webshop mit den nötigen Grundnaschungsmitteln versorgen. Infos zur Eröffnung erhaltet ihr natürlich rechtzeitig in einem eigenen Eck-strablatt. Bis bald, Eure süßen Eck-sperten Raphaela und Nicole

candidateAudit.text: Kulinarischer Jahresauftakt 2024 Nun ist es da, das neue Jahr und während es draußen immer kälter wird, sorgen wir für gemütliche Wärme und wohlige Genüsse auf unseren Goldrandtellern. Wir servieren Ihnen den kulinarischen Auftakt in mehrgängigen Menüs oder auch à la carte. Verbringen Sie einen gemütlichen Abend mit Freunden oder Familie. Wir halten für Sie auf unserer Speisekarte zahlreiche winterliche Genüsse bereit und servieren Ihnen geräuchertes Beef Tartar, Mille-feuille von der Sellerie mit Ziegenkäse oder mollige Consommé von dreierlei Schwammerln als Vorspeise. Als Hauptgang bieten wir vegetarisch Butternuss-Kürbis mit Bergkäse, aber auch Kabeljau auf einer Beurre Blanc, rosa gebratenes Rückenfilet vom Kalb und geschmortes Lamm. candidateAudit.title: Danke für John Mariani vom Forbes Magazine für den Besuch im Ludwig van und den schönen Artikel und Dank auch an wien.info für die Vermittlung! “A most unusual restaurant named Lud
candidateAudit.text: Danke für John Mariani vom Forbes Magazine für den Besuch im Ludwig van und den schönen Artikel und Dank auch an wien.info für die Vermittlung! “A most unusual restaurant named Ludwig Van (Laimgrubengasse 22), run since 2015 by the ebullient, highly opinionated Oliver Jauk, is located on the ground floor of what was once Ludwig von Beethoven’s residence, now preserved. It has the feeling of a country tavern inside, and there is an extensive wine list that Jauk puts to good use for his tasting menus paired with wines (extra), that are always changing. We began with an amuse of tȇte de veau with white beans and red onions, followed by a series of savory dishes (four course €79, five €89, six €99) like finely-chopped beef tartare with smoked capers, radish and crouton; a consommé of mushrooms with egg yolk and truffles; cod in a rich, ivory-colored beurre blanc with sweet potato tinged with orange; delicious and tender veal with a buttery fondant of potatoes and wild broccoli; rosy lamb with spiced rice, fig and pistachio (which showed off the chef’s Turkish heritage); for dessert a Mont Blanc with candied chestnut and tangerine; and a delightful gingerbread with honey, apple and walnut. It is a sumptuous meal but dishes are kept to a moderate size, so you might even indulge in the four varieties of local cheeses before your petits-fours. Jauk, who says he is more a marketer than gastronome, nevertheless knows his wines, and he’s to be trusted with his choices matched to this sophisticated take on modern European cuisine.” John Mariani Forbes Magazine http://www.forbes.com/sit

candidateAudit.text: Gault&Millau Restaurantguide 2024 Ludwig van 3 Hauben (15,5 Punkte) Danke, Danke, Danke für jede einzelne Haube, die wir auch dieses Jahr wieder vom Gault&Millau verliehen bekommen haben. Wir bedanken uns vor allem bei unseren Mitarbeitern für ihre unermüdliche Leistung und Ihre gute Arbeit! „Erfreulich frei von Beethoven-Kitsch ist das Ludwig van im ehemaligen Wohnhaus des Komponisten. Chef Oliver Jauk legt darauf keinen Wert, weshalb wir die übliche, mit Beethoven-Anspielung garnierte Beschreibung dieses wunderschönen Gasthauses gleich vorweg abfeiern wollen: Auffallend und gut, dass Jauk und sein Küchenteam in diesem Traditionsbetrieb auch modernen Strömungen Gehör schenken! Noch etwas unsicher bei der nicht ganz stimmigen Kombination von Kohlroulade mit Artischocke und Nüssen, umso gelungener aber bei einer sich mehr als Fond erweisenden Zwiebelsuppe mit Bergkäse und Majoran. Subtiler, aber nicht weniger auf dem Punkt: der Pulpo mit Granny Smith sowie der Loup de mer mit Kerbelknolle, Haselnuss und brauner Butter. Absoluter Höhepunkt sind aber Backerl und Bauch vom Ötscher-Schwein, die an Zartheit und gleichzeitiger Intensität nicht zu übertreffen sind. Dazu serviert Patron Jauk eine mit Überraschungen gespickte Weinbegleitung, die sich ebenfalls moderner Stilistik nicht verschließt.“ #igers #igersvienna #igersaustria #vienna #wien #viennacity #viennaaustria #ilovevienna #austriatoday #wienstagram #instavienna #viennanow #ludwigvan #gastronomie #instafood #cuisine #dinner #dinnertime #gourmet #gaultmillau #foodporn #restaurant #culinary #instagood #chefofinstagram #food
